(()=>{const T=RACE.T,N=T.N,k=Math.floor(N*.85),c=Math.cos(T.psi[k]),s=Math.sin(T.psi[k]);const cam=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60,16/9,.1,3000);cam.position.set(T.x[k],T.y[k]+5,T.z[k]);const k2=(k+25)%N;cam.lookAt(T.x[k2],T.y[k2]+1,T.z[k2]);cam.updateMatrixWorld();const rc=new THREE.Raycaster(),out=[];for(const p of [[-.8,.16],[-.7,.2],[-.9,.1],[-.6,.12],[-.75,.05]]){rc.setFromCamera(new THREE.Vector2(p[0],p[1]),cam);const h=rc.intersectObjects(RACE.scene.children,true).filter(x=>x.object.visible).slice(0,4).map(x=>{const o=x.object;return (o.name||'?')+'/'+o.type+'/'+o.geometry.type+'/'+(o.geometry.attributes.position.count)+'/'+(o.material.type)+'/'+(o.material.color?o.material.color.getHexString():'')+'/'+(o.material.map?'map':'')+'/par:'+(o.parent&&(o.parent.name||o.parent.type))+'@'+x.distance.toFixed(1)});out.push(h.join(' | '))}return JSON.stringify(out)})()
